quotes.text: Learn how to set up your integration with Billie.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Billie is a [single-use](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods.md#usage) payment method that offers businesses Pay by Invoice where they offer payment terms ranging from 7-120 days.
You can create Billie payments in the currencies that map to your country. The default local currency for Billie is `eur`.

Stripe cancels the PaymentIntent and sends a [payment_intent.canceled](https://docs.stripe.com/api/events/types.md#event_types-payment_intent.canceled) event if the payment isn’t captured during the 7-day window.

findings: Semantic delta: the November capture contains only a variant index, not refreshed integration details (new raw lines 9-20; diff lines 3-21 and 1915-1922). Its six links route to Checkout, Elements with Checkout Sessions or Payment Intents, Direct API, iOS, and Android. No removal, deprecation, currency change or eligibility change follows from the shorter capture.

Baseline summary accuracy: current source lines 13 and 19 conflate Checkout/Elements currency scope and state return_url as universally required. The May guide marks Checkout and Checkout Sessions compatibility as EUR (old raw lines 22-41 and 101-118), but the old mobile sections list EUR, SEK, NOK, DKK, GBP and CHF by country (old raw lines 1657-1664 and 1877-1884). The Payment Intents Elements section uses EUR examples (old raw lines 640-675 and 813-835), rather than declaring an Elements-wide EUR-only rule. A return_url is documented for redirect confirmations (old raw lines 933-939 and 1299-1327), whereas hosted Checkout shows success_url in its example (old raw lines 49-75).

Baseline summary omits mobile paths even though the older guide has iOS and Android sections (old raw lines 1409-1415 and 1684-1690), and the new index exposes them (new raw lines 18-20). Source correction should preserve distinct dated paths and link the new index as navigation while retaining the full May raw.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May 6, 2026 guide: Billie single-use B2B Pay by Invoice, 7-120 day terms, redirect/notification description (old raw lines 1-20); November index does not reconfirm those mechanics (new raw lines 5-20).

May guide: Checkout/Checkout Sessions EUR compatibility and same-currency Checkout line items (old raw lines 22-41 and 101-118); mobile country-currency matrix (old raw lines 1657-1664 and 1877-1884). Preserve the path distinction rather than an undated universal EUR claim.

May guide: PaymentIntent manual capture is optional; after authorization reaches requires_capture, capture within seven days or the intent is canceled (old raw lines 1100-1146). The November index does not revise this.
May guide: Unified line_items recommendation is for maximizing approval rates with early access caveat (old raw lines 8-10 and 1148-1152); not a universal required field.

May guide: sandbox Billie flow offers approve/decline test page while live mode redirects to Billie; post-payment actions should listen for payment_intent.succeeded rather than rely on client callbacks (old raw lines 1154-1158 and 1082-1094). SDK references, including dahlia Stripe.js and Android 23.7.0, remain dated examples (old raw lines 214-240 and 1708-1732).
conflicts: Current source line 19's 'EUR only for Checkout/Elements integration' should be narrowed to Checkout and Checkout Sessions compatibility; old raw mobile currency lists at lines 1657-1664 and 1877-1884 and the related Billie summary at wiki/sources/source-stripe-billie.md lines 17 and 31 show broader country-dependent currencies. The November index provides no new resolution.

Current source line 19's unqualified 'return_url required' should identify redirect confirmation scope. Old raw lines 933-939, 1299-1327 and 49-75 distinguish PaymentIntent confirmation from hosted Checkout's success_url example; new raw lines 13-17 only name variants.
unresolved_questions: The November variant targets were not fetched in this approved review-only packet, so their current behavior, supported currencies, SDK versions and availability remain unverified (new raw lines 11-20).

findings: Correct the existing summary's universal Elements EUR and return_url wording (current source line 19 versus old raw lines 22-41, 101-118, 933-939, 1299-1327 and 1657-1664). Add November variant index as navigation with separate provenance; retain the May full guide and dated claims (new raw lines 9-20; current source lines 4-7, 13-29).
conflicts: The related Billie product summary records multi-currency country mapping (wiki/sources/source-stripe-billie.md lines 17 and 31), while this integration summary's EUR-only Elements wording is too broad (current source line 19).
source_assessments.reason: A navigation-only new capture warrants provenance/navigation routing, and the full historical review independently exposed a material baseline summary scope error. The proposed source update is a later coordinator decision, not an inference of changed Stripe behavior.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/billie/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture establishes a Billie integration index with Checkout, Elements through Checkout Sessions or Payment Intents, Direct API, iOS and Android destinations (new raw lines 5-20); it establishes no payment outcome or current eligibility. The May full guide describes single-use B2B Pay by Invoice with 7-120 day terms, server-created Checkout Sessions or PaymentIntents and client confirmation/redirect, plus separate EUR Checkout compatibility and country-dependent mobile currencies (old raw lines 20-41, 131-165, 813-835, 933-939, 1657-1664). The mapped source-stripe-billie-accept-payment.md summarizes the older guide but overstates an Elements-wide EUR restriction and an unqualified return_url requirement (current source lines 13-25); it omits the old mobile variants. A Session, Intent, client secret, redirect and payment_intent.succeeded event are distinct states or artifacts, and the index alone verifies none of their current runtime behavior.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/billie/accept-a-payment, the November change is presentation/navigation: six variant links replace the May combined long guide in this capture (new raw lines 9-20; old raw lines 12-20 and 1409-1415). No substantive API, eligibility, currency or deprecation change is proven. source-stripe-billie-accept-payment.md should retain dated 7-120 day terms, Checkout EUR compatibility, optional seven-day manual capture, early-access line_items advice, sandbox/live distinctions and webhook outcome boundary (old raw lines 20-41, 1082-1158), while correcting its broad currency and return_url wording (current source lines 17-25). Related Billie product details list broader country currencies, creating a scope conflict requiring a reciprocal warning or narrower source phrasing (wiki/sources/source-stripe-billie.md lines 17-31). Historical dahlia and mobile SDK examples remain May-version evidence; client confirmation, browser return, server resource creation or mobile callback must not be promoted into a current success, settlement or eligibility claim.
